rationale.edition: The change spans both open-source and enterprise-owned paths. OSS paths include src/api/... (http handler, management request password_policy), src/config/src/meta/system_settings.rs, src/db/src/password_policy.rs, src/infra/src/table/..., and the web/src/** password-policy UI. Enterprise paths include o2_enterprise/src/enterprise/password_policy/ (enforcement, history, lockout, meta, validate, mod) and o2_openfga/src/meta/route_permissions.rs. This is a linked OSS+ENT sister pair, so edition is 'both'.
rationale.skip: Not skipped. feature_hint.txt and trigger_comment.txt are empty (no tests-added label, no skip comment), and the change is clearly user-facing — it adds a Settings password-policy page plus login/add-user/update-password validation and an expiry banner in web/src/**, so it is not docs-only or CI-only.
rationale.e2e: E2E is warranted: the diff adds and alters user-exercisable UI flows, including the Settings → Password Policy page (PasswordPolicy.vue), password requirement feedback on Login.vue and AddUser.vue, the UpdatePasswordDialog and PasswordRequirementList, and a PasswordExpiryBanner. These are new/changed interactions and validation paths that need behavior verification.
rationale.area: Area is GeneralTests because the bulk of the UI changes live under web/src/components/settings/ (with supporting common/login/IAM-user components), and the closest sibling specs — settings-form-validation, login-form-validation, iam-form-validation, usersOrg — all live under tests/ui-testing/playwright-tests/GeneralTests/. There is no dedicated Settings shard in the matrix.
rationale.group: playwright_group is GeneralTests because password policy is a general security/settings feature, analogous to the settings/security specs already in that shard (theme-management, cipherKeys, logoManagement, languageTranslation). If that shard is at capacity, GeneralTests-Forms (which already holds settings-form-validation.spec.js) is the nearest fallback.
rationale.existing_tests: No Playwright E2E specs in the diff — no files under tests/ui-testing/playwright-tests/ were changed. The .spec.ts files under web/src/** (PasswordRequirementList.spec.ts, UpdatePasswordDialog.spec.ts, Login.spec.ts, passwordComplexity.spec.ts, etc.) are Vitest unit tests, not E2E coverage, and tests/integration_test.rs is a Rust test — neither counts as existing E2E coverage.
